holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: ICICI Bank reported Q2 FY2027 standalone profit of ₹14,843 crore and consolidated net profit of ₹16,333 crore, with quarterly revenue reaching ₹55,992 crore.
The bank's CASA ratio dropped by 340 bps to 36.1% as FCNR (B) deposits surged.
The bank announced revisions to select savings account cash transaction charges effective December 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: As the fund's largest holding at 9.28%, ICICI Bank has delivered positive 1M returns of 4.40% and a 3M return of -2.52%, helping cushion the broader sell-off across financial holdings.

watch.text: Implementation and customer impact of revised savings account transaction charges starting December 1, 2026.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Revenue for the quarter ended September 2026 rose to ₹95,132 crore with net profit at ₹21,537 crore.
The bank initiated an internal probe regarding allegations that two senior executives leaked confidential business information.
Deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha is scheduled to step down on December 31, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: With an 8.56% allocation, HDFC Bank was the fund's biggest detractor over the last 3 months, posting a -7.12% return and contributing -0.609% to fund performance.

watch.text: Developments and regulatory scrutiny concerning the internal data leak investigation involving two senior executives.
Executive leadership transition as Kaizad Bharucha ceases to be Deputy MD on December 31, 2026.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the September 2026 quarter came in at ₹7,666 crore on revenue of ₹38,087 crore, but shares fell after profit missed expectations.
Rahul Shukla was appointed as Group Head of Commercial and Bharat Banking, effective October 19, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 4.90% fund weight, the stock has declined -0.90% over 3 months and -11.51% over 6 months, contributing to the broader pressure on the fund's 42.1% Financials basket.

watch.text: Trajectory of loan growth following revised broker estimates pointing toward 20% in FY27.

holdings.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit grew to ₹5,998 crore in the June 2026 quarter on sales of ₹58,188 crore with an operating margin of 19%.
The company's stake in NDET decreased from 72.07% to 49.63%, resulting in NDET ceasing to be a step-down subsidiary.

holdings.why_it_matters: Accounting for 4.10% of the portfolio, M&M was the second-largest detractor over 3 months, dropping -11.32% and knocking -0.464% off the fund's returns.

watch.text: Subsidiary performance following sharp post-earnings volatility at Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: Revenue reached ₹136,240 crore and net profit stood at ₹25,121 crore for the June 2026 quarter.
SBI reported a cyber incident exposing 3,897 customer records on the dark web, though confirming customer balances remained secure.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.43% weight, SBI is down -4.21% over 3 months and -11.35% over 6 months, adding to the fund's heavy financial drag.

watch.text: Regulatory feedback and remediation following the exposure of dark web customer records.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: Sales grew to ₹58,539 crore with net profit of ₹10,012 crore in the June 2026 quarter.
The company launched DPDP-compliant enterprise platform IQ Gateway and updated postpaid roaming bundles.
The Department of Telecommunications levied minor penalties totaling under ₹15 lakh across September and October 2026 for subscriber verification norm violations.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 2.84% of the fund, the stock gained 4.28% over 1 month, balancing weak performance across discretionary and banking names.

watch.text: Adoption and competitive impact of newly launched mass-market voice tariffs and international roaming offerings.

holdings.name: Cholamandalam Investment & Finance Company Ltd

what_changed.text: Revenue reached ₹8,856 crore with net profit of ₹1,656 crore in the June 2026 quarter.
The board scheduled a meeting for October 28, 2026 to review Q2 results and consider a QIP capital raising.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.33% position, the stock dropped -12.97% in the past month and -10.85% over 3 months, magnifying the NBFC and banking downturn in the portfolio.

watch.text: Outcome of the board's decision regarding QIP capital raising and Q2 financial performance on October 28, 2026.

holdings.name: Cipla Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 quarter net profit fell to ₹786 crore compared to ₹1,292 crore in June 2025, with operating profit margin dipping to 17%.
Cipla entered an agreement to establish a manufacturing unit in Iran and conducted a recall for a UTI medication in the US.

holdings.why_it_matters: Cipla holds a 2.30% weight, providing some defense against financials with a positive 6-month gain of 1.91%, despite falling -4.46% in the last 3 months.

watch.text: Q2 and half-year FY26 financial statements scheduled for approval at the October 27, 2026 board meeting.

holdings.name: SBI Life Insurance Company Ltd

what_changed.text: The company received a GST demand notice of ₹1.13 crore for the April-August 2025 period, which it plans to contest.
IRDAI introduced new commission caps and distribution regulations, with brokerages assessing SBI Life as relatively insulated versus peers.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.23% allocation, SBI Life detracted -0.253% from fund returns over 3 months as its share price dropped -11.36%.

watch.text: Earnings release and margin impact from regulatory commission norms following the October 27, 2026 board meeting.

holdings.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd

what_changed.text: Q2 FY2027 net profit rose to ₹6,367 crore on revenue of ₹24,546 crore, while Gross NPA ticked up to 1.06% from 0.96% in the prior quarter.
The company allotted ₹2,120 crore in secured NCDs maturing in October 2031.
News reports highlighted expected net interest margin (NIM) pressure due to elevated funding costs.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.21% weight, Bajaj Finance fell -9.40% over 3 months and -6.61% over 1 month, compounding drag from financial holdings.

watch.text: Trend in funding costs and its subsequent impact on lending margins in upcoming quarters.

portfolio.statement: DSP Flexi Cap Fund declined -4.72% over the last 3 months, heavily pulled down by its 42.1% allocation to Financials.
interp: The fund's core concentration in banking and lending leaders generated the bulk of its underperformance, with HDFC Bank, Max Financial Services, and SBI Life Insurance leading the losses.
Gains in IT and Technology positions like Coforge, Tech Mahindra, and Infosys provided partial positive offsets, but were not sufficient to counteract financial sector weakness.
portfolio.line: Heavy banking exposure steered portfolio drawdown despite strength in selective technology positions.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank declined -7.12% over 3 months, generating a -0.609% return drag on the fund amid an internal data leak probe and management transition.
Mahindra & Mahindra retreated -11.32% over 3 months, deducting -0.464% from total portfolio performance.
SBI Life Insurance declined -11.36%, detracting -0.253% alongside regulatory shifts around commission caps.

themes.title: Banking and Financial Sector Dominance
themes.text: With over 42% in Financials, the fund is tied directly to the earnings trajectory, deposit dynamics, and regulatory developments of major Indian commercial banks and NBFCs.

themes.title: Enterprise and Telecom Digital Services
themes.text: Exposure across telecom infrastructure and IT solutions provided relative stabilization against declining domestic cyclical names.

macro.why: Rising cost of funds and shifts in deposit profiles are dampening margins across private and public lenders.
Tighter oversight spanning IRDAI commission caps and data security protocols has created operational headwinds for lenders and insurers.

priced_in.text: HDFC Bank's multi-quarter share weakness and negative 1-year return of -31.13% reflects ongoing market adjustment to executive changes and operational inquiries.

could_change.title: NBFC Capital Inflows
could_change.text: Upcoming capital raising by Cholamandalam Investment & Finance through a proposed QIP could reshape balance sheet leverage and growth capacity.

portfolio.risk_note: With a top 10 concentration of 42.2% and a financial sector weighting of 42.1%, the portfolio is exposed to severe sector-specific downside whenever banking valuations correct.
